# Libraries

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(foreign)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

library(lavaan)
library(EGAnet)
library(psych)
```

# I. Data preparation

## 1. Import the data

```{r}
d0 = read_sav("TBIMS_cleaned.sav") %>%
  mutate(across(1:26 & where(haven::is.labelled), haven::as_factor),
         across(-(1:26), \(x) { attributes(x) = NULL; x }) ) %>%
  haven::zap_formats()
```

**Prepare the data**

Keep only timepoints 1-4 and remove "PRTVol"

```{r}
parto0 = d0 %>%
  select(UID, Age, Race, Sex, Mar, EduYears,
         Cause, CTComp, GCSTot,
         matches("PRT.*\\.[1-4]$", ignore.case=FALSE), -matches("PRTVol"))
```

Recode items into ordered factors (with 0-5)

```{r}
parto0 = parto0 %>%
  mutate(across(matches("^PRT(Home|School|Work)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 4 Hours", "5 - 9 Hours",
                                     "10 - 19 Hours", "20 - 34 Hours",
                                     "35 or More Hours"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(SocFrnd|SocFam|EmotSup|Internet|EatOut|Shop|PlaySport)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 4 Times", "5 - 9 Times",
                                     "10 - 19 Times", "20 - 34 Times",
                                     "35 or More Times"))),
         across(matches("^PRTOutHse\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:4,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 2 Days", "3 - 4 Days",
                                     "5 - 6 Days", "7 Days"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(Movie|WtchSport|Religion)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "One Time", "Two Times",
                                     "Three Times", "Four Times",
                                     "Five or More Times"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(Spouse|Relation|Friend)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:1, labels = c("No", "Yes"))) )
```

## 2. Remove missing data

Create columns for missing data

```{r}
parto0 <- parto0 %>%
  mutate(
    missing_T1 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".1"), is.na)),
    missing_T2 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".2"), is.na)),
    missing_T3 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".3"), is.na)),
    missing_T4 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".4"), is.na)) )
```

Check complete data per timepoint

```{r}
parto0 %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_2 = sum(missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_3 = sum(missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_4 = sum(missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) )
```

### T1 dataset A (17 items)

```{r}
T1_partoA <- parto0 %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("PRT.*\\.1$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("PRT.*\\.1$"))
nrow(T1_partoA)
```

### T1 dataset B (16 items)

**Problematic item**

Some CFAs flag issues with two items correlating too closely

| `simpleWarning: lavaan->lav_samp_step2():correlation between variables PRTRelation.1 and PRTSpouse.1 is (nearly) 1.0`

Check correlation between the similar items (PRTRelation and PRTSpouse)

```{r}
lavCor(T1_partoA[, c("PRTRelation.1", "PRTSpouse.1")])[2,1]
```

- Since correlation is too high, check the variability of each item

```{r}
sapply(T1_partoA[, c("PRTRelation.1","PRTSpouse.1")],
       function(x) {p <- prop.table(table(x))[1]
                    p * (1 - p) })
```

- Since "PRTSpouse" has lower variability, the item will be removed in some analyses, while keeping "PRTRelation"

**Corrected dataset**

```{r}
T1_partoB <- parto0 %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("PRT.*\\.1$") & !matches("Spouse"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("PRT.*\\.1$") & !matches("Spouse"))
nrow(T1_partoB)
```

## 3. Final prep

Create a vectors with fit indices names

```{r}
names_fit = c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "cfi.scaled",
              "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled",
              "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")

names_short = c("chisq", "df", "chisq/df", "cfi", "rmsea",
                "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "srmr")
```

Remove unnecessary objects

```{r}
rm(d0, parto0)
```

# II. Confirmatory Factor Analyses (CFAs)

## 1. Unidimensional

### A. 17-items

Create the model

```{r}
mod_uni17 = 'Participation =~ PRTHome.1 + PRTSchool.1 + PRTWork.1
                           + PRTSocFrnd.1 + PRTSocFam.1
                           + PRTEmotSup.1 + PRTInternet.1
                           + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                           + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                           + PRTReligion.1 + PRTSpouse.1
                           + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

Fit and check the model

```{r}
fit_uni17 = cfa(mod_uni17, data=T1_partoA, ordered=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV")
fitMeasures(fit_uni17, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

### B. 16-items

Create the model

```{r}
mod_uni16 = 'Participation =~ PRTHome.1 + PRTSchool.1 + PRTWork.1
                           + PRTSocFrnd.1 + PRTSocFam.1
                           + PRTEmotSup.1 + PRTInternet.1
                           + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                           + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                           + PRTReligion.1 + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

Fit and check the model

```{r}
fit_uni16 = cfa(mod_uni16, data=T1_partoB, ordered=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV")
fitMeasures(fit_uni16, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

```{r}
rm(mod_uni17, fit_uni17)
```

           SocialRelations =~ PRTSocFrnd.1 + PRTSocFam.1 + PRTEmotSup.1
                            + PRTInternet.1 + PRTSpouse.1 + PRTRelation.1
                            + PRTFriend.1

Fit and check the model

fit_theo17 = cfa(mod_theo17, data=T1_partoA, ordered=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV")
lavInspect(fit_theo17, "cor.lv")

## 5. Malec's version

**Malec's modifications**

- Productivity item: summed the 3 productivity items (items 1-3: Home, School, Work)
- Social interaction item: summed the 4 social interaction items (items 4-7: SocFrnd, SocFam, EmotSup, Internet)
- Remove overlapping item: remove Spouse (item 15), since its responses are included in Relation (item 16)

```{r}
# New summed items
M1_partoA <- T1_partoB %>%
  # Turn relevant items into numeric
  mutate(across(10:16, \(x) as.numeric(x) - 1)) %>%
  # Sum the items
  mutate(
    PRTProductivity.1 = rowSums(pick(PRTHome.1, PRTSchool.1, PRTWork.1)),
    PRTSocial.1 = rowSums(pick(PRTSocFrnd.1, PRTSocFam.1,
                               PRTEmotSup.1, PRTInternet.1)))

# Re-scale the items
M1_partoA <- M1_partoA %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("PRTProductivity."), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x == 1 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 2:3 ~ 2,
      .x %in% 4:6 ~ 3,
      .x >= 7 ~ 4, TRUE ~ NA)),
    across(starts_with("PRTSocial."), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x %in% 1:4 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 5:9 ~ 2,
      .x %in% 10:14 ~ 3,
      .x >= 15 ~ 4, TRUE ~ NA)) )

# Items as factors
M1_partoA <- M1_partoA %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("PRTProductivity."), ~ factor(.x, levels = 0:4, ordered = TRUE)),
    across(starts_with("PRTSocial."), ~ factor(.x, levels = 0:4, ordered = TRUE)) )

# Re-order items and remove Spouse
M1_partoA <- M1_partoA %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("^PRT(Productivity|Social)\\.1$"),
         matches("^PRT(OutHse|EatOut|Shop|PlaySport|Movie)\\.1$"),
         matches("^PRT(WtchSport|Religion|Relation|Friend)\\.1$"))
```

### A. Unidimensional

Create the model

```{r}
mod_uni11 = 'Participation =~ PRTProductivity.1 + PRTSocial.1
                           + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                           + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                           + PRTReligion.1 + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

Fit and check the model

```{r}
fit_uni11 = cfa(mod_uni11, data=M1_partoA, ordered=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV")
fitMeasures(fit_uni11, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

### B. Collapsing categories

Sensitivity analysis, testing possible fit improvement when collapsing categories.

**Collapse categories**

```{r}
M1_partoB <- M1_partoA %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("PRT(OutHse|EatOut|Shop)"), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x %in% 1:2 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 3:5 ~ 2, TRUE ~ NA)),
    across(starts_with("PRT(PlaySport|Movie|WtchSport|Religion)"), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x %in% 1:4 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 5 ~ 2, TRUE ~ NA)) )
```

Create the model

```{r}
mod_uni11B = 'Participation =~ PRTProductivity.1 + PRTSocial.1
                           + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                           + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                           + PRTReligion.1 + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

Fit and check the model

```{r}
fit_uni11B = cfa(mod_uni11B, data=M1_partoB, ordered=TRUE, estimator="WLSMV")
fitMeasures(fit_uni11B, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

```{r}
rm(T1_partoA, T1_partoB)
rm(M1_partoA, M1_partoB)
```

## Comparison

### 1. Unidimensional (16items)

**Model specification**

```{r}
mod_uni16 = 'Participation =~ PRTHome.1 + PRTSchool.1 + PRTWork.1
                           + PRTSocFrnd.1 + PRTSocFam.1
                           + PRTEmotSup.1 + PRTInternet.1
                           + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                           + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                           + PRTReligion.1 + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

**Fit indices**

```{r}
fitMeasures(fit_uni16, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Standardized loadings**

```{r}
standardizedSolution(fit_uni16) %>%
  filter(op == "=~") %>%
  select(lhs, rhs, est.std, pvalue)
```

**Reliability**

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
semTools::reliability(fit_uni16)
```

### Fit indices

```{r}
Comp <- rbind(Original = fitMeasures(fit_uni16, fit.measures = names_fit),
              Malec = fitMeasures(fit_uni11, fit.measures = names_fit),
              Collapsed = fitMeasures(fit_uni11B, fit.measures = names_fit))

Comp <- Comp %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

Comp = round(Comp, 3)
colnames(Comp) = names_short
Comp
```
